slot_decisions.authoring_scope: Teacher-facing note may explain the approved context/place lexical evidence and its limits; it must not assert locative grammar.
Teacher-facing note may explain the approved activity lexical evidence and its limits; it must not assert declarative or tense grammar.
Teacher-facing note may explain lexical intention, need and purpose evidence and its limits; it must not assert modal syntax.

governance_decisions.statement: Author only Teacher Notes TN-001..003 from approved source lanes; create no new HNK forms.
HABITUALITY_EVIDENCE_ONLY / SARU may appear only as a boundary reminder; it is not a standalone Teacher Note slot and is not equivalent to usually.
Teacher Notes authoring does not promote FROZEN/WATCH/CANDIDATE authority and creates no universal grammar.
Vocabulary 009-016 remain unresolved and all OPI, QA, Structures, Story, Activation and Review lanes remain untouched.
Reference languages remain comparative only and numerology remains allocation-only.
If approved, author only TN-001..003 and then open a separate Teacher Notes validation gate; do not validate with the same approval.
